notes: sigit is a local-inference agent (Onde Inference, 'no API keys, no cloud round-trips') — nothing to wire; probed as-is. Whether its bundled model runs in CI is itself a data point. --acp is explicit ACP mode (it also auto-detects non-TTY stdio). Agent defect worth knowing: an unanswered authenticate (browser OAuth) head-of-line blocks its serialized dispatch loop — the probe authenticates last so the wedge can't swallow the suite.
